cases.source: Maya missed her morning train after a signal failure near Bristol. She called her manager, booked a later service and arrived forty minutes late. The rail company refunded part of her ticket, but Maya still missed the client meeting. On her way home, she decided to check the service app before leaving the house next time.

The design team now meets in the office on Tuesdays and works remotely for the rest of the week. Some staff say the arrangement saves commuting time, while new employees find it harder to ask quick questions. The manager introduced a daily ten-minute video check-in and a shared project board to make responsibilities clear.
